description: Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant for managing your wardrobe or closet, discovering ways to wear your clothes, and finding what to wear with an item. Search and add clothes you own, explore outfit inspiration and complementary pieces, and get personalised outfit suggestions for the weather and occasion.

defaultPrompt: I'm going for a winter walk in a park. What shall I wear?
what can I wear with a dark blue shirt?
Show me the shirts in my wardrobe.
interface.longDescription:
Able.Style helps you manage your wardrobe and explore your personal fashion and style. Build a digital closet, discover new ways to wear the clothes you own, and find outfits that suit your preferences, the occasion and the weather.

Manage your wardrobe and closet: browse and search your saved clothes by category, colour and other details. Add a clothing item from a text description or a photo. Save items from outfit suggestions when you own the same or a similar piece, and remove pieces you no longer have.

Find what to wear with an item: start with a piece from your wardrobe or an outfit suggestion, such as a dark blue shirt, and discover complementary clothing styles and items from your own wardrobe. Explore combinations that help you get more use from your existing clothes.

See ways to wear it: browse outfit inspiration showing how a particular shirt, jacket, pair of trousers or other item can be styled. Explore the clothing items in each outfit to discover more fashion ideas and style combinations.

Get complete outfit suggestions: ask what to wear for work, a weekend walk or another occasion, with options for different temperatures and levels of formality. Recommendations can use your saved wardrobe, style preferences and local weather. Like or dislike suggested outfits to refine future recommendations.

Find matching products: discover products and retailers for supported catalogue styles, with price and availability information and links to retailer product pages.

Sign in to search and manage your wardrobe, explore ways to wear and what to wear with an item, find matching products, and save your preferences.

publication.release_notes: Expand the Able.Style introduction to cover wardrobe and closet management, ways to wear individual items, complementary clothing, outfit suggestions and matching products. Update the starter prompts to include item styling and wardrobe search.
